$comment: Training the law requires, by jurisdiction and sector, for docs/29 and migration 0015. The loader writes each entry into ref.training_requirement in Step 17. An organization's rule that carries one out can be stricter, never looser (TRAINING_RULE_LOOSER_THAN_LAW); an entry still marked verify_at_load cannot be applied (RULE_NOT_VERIFIED). Every entry is checked against the statute before it is used for a customer; secondary means taken from a reliable secondary summary, official from the government's own text.

fields.audience: Who must take it: roles (worker, supervisor, employee, designated_recipient, new_worker, young_worker, employer_representative), hazards, sectors. The organization's training rule turns this into its own scope (jobs, positions, locations, supervisors).
fields.before_work: The training must be done before the person starts the work it covers; a rule that carries it out blocks scheduling for that work.
fields.due_days: Days from the event (hire, new role) by which it must be done; null where the law gives no number (see due_note).
fields.frequency_months: How often it must be repeated; null where the law sets no refresher.

requirements.name_fr: Formation sur la prévention du harcèlement et de la violence (employés)
requirements.due_note: Within three months after the day employment begins; again after the training is updated, or when assigned an activity or role with increased or specific risk
requirements.cite: Work Place Harassment and Violence Prevention Regulations, SOR/2020-130, s. 12(4)

requirements.name_en: Harassment and violence prevention training (designated recipient)
requirements.name_fr: Formation sur la prévention du harcèlement et de la violence (destinataire désigné)
requirements.due_note: Before assuming their duties under the Regulations

requirements.name_fr: Formation sur la prévention du harcèlement et de la violence (employeur)
requirements.due_note: Within one year after the Regulations came into force, then at least every three years

requirements.name_en: Young or new worker health and safety orientation and training
requirements.name_fr: Orientation et formation en santé et sécurité des jeunes et nouveaux travailleurs
requirements.due_note: Before a young or new worker begins work in a workplace; a new worker includes one returning after hazards changed or relocated to a workplace with different hazards; a young worker is under 25
requirements.cite: BC Occupational Health and Safety Regulation, ss. 3.22, 3.23 (records: s. 3.25)

requirements.name_en: Worker health and safety awareness training
requirements.name_fr: Formation de sensibilisation à la santé et à la sécurité (travailleurs)
requirements.due_note: As soon as practicable; prior training with written proof may count
requirements.cite: O. Reg. 297/13 (Occupational Health and Safety Awareness and Training)

requirements.name_en: Supervisor health and safety awareness training
requirements.name_fr: Formation de sensibilisation à la santé et à la sécurité (superviseurs)
requirements.due_note: Within one week of performing work as a supervisor

requirements.name_en: WHMIS training for workers who work with or near hazardous products
requirements.name_fr: Formation SIMDUT pour les travailleurs exposés à des produits dangereux
requirements.due_note: Before working with or near hazardous products; the employer reviews the training program at least once a year (whether that means retraining is to verify)
requirements.cite: R.R.O. 1990, Reg. 860 (WHMIS) under the Occupational Health and Safety Act

requirements.due_note: Before working with or near hazardous products; the employer reviews the training program at least once a year (whether that means retraining is to verify)
requirements.cite: BC Occupational Health and Safety Regulation, Part 5 (WHMIS)

requirements.name_fr: Formation SIMDUT (lieux de travail sous réglementation fédérale)
requirements.due_note: Before handling or being exposed to hazardous products
requirements.cite: Canada Occupational Health and Safety Regulations, Part X

requirements.name_en: Accessible customer service and Human Rights Code training
requirements.name_fr: Formation sur le service à la clientèle accessible et le Code des droits de la personne
requirements.due_note: As soon as practicable; again when policies change
requirements.cite: O. Reg. 191/11 (Integrated Accessibility Standards), ss. 7 and 80.49

requirements.name_en: Information and instruction on the workplace harassment and violence programs
requirements.name_fr: Information et directives sur les programmes contre le harcèlement et la violence au travail
requirements.due_note: Appropriate information and instruction on the contents of the policy and program; the program is reviewed at least once a year (whether that means retraining is to verify)
requirements.cite: Occupational Health and Safety Act, ss. 32.0.2, 32.0.7

BC.rule: Records of all orientation and training under ss. 3.23 and 3.24 must be kept; no period stated in the section

ON.rule: Proof of completed awareness training is given to a worker or supervisor who asks within six months of ceasing to work for the employer

quebec_workforce_skills.shortfall: Pay the difference between 1% of payroll and eligible training expenses to the Fonds de développement et de reconnaissance des compétences de la main-d'œuvre, on the RL-1 summary (RLZ-1.S), by the last day of February of the following year
quebec_workforce_skills.cite: Act to promote workforce skills development and recognition; Revenu Québec

training_taxable_benefit.rule: Training mainly for the employer's benefit is not taxable: specific employment-related training to maintain or upgrade job skills, and general business-related courses such as stress management, employment equity, first aid and language courses. Training mainly for the employee's benefit (personal interest, or technical skills unrelated to the employer's business) is a taxable benefit. HR marks each request (docs/29 §8.2).
training_taxable_benefit.cite: Canada Revenue Agency, Educational assistance (employer-paid training)
